question: What sin is a seven-faced rudrākṣa said to destroy always?
premises: The seven-faced rudrākṣa is identified as Ananta
It is described as destroying the sin of gold theft
This effect is said to hold always
inference: A seven-faced rudrākṣa, as Ananta, always destroys the sin of stealing gold.
plain_english: But the seven-faced rudrākṣa is Ananta, always the destroyer of the sin of stealing gold.
